source_roots: skills agents gates hooks evals .github scripts .claude-plugin README.md .gitignore reference .claude/project.json .claude/gates
unit_test_scope: the whole target — every self-test runs in seconds, so there is no subset worth choosing
post_fix_verification_scope: everything — there is no selector, and a full run is seconds
verification_tiers: ci (a named step in .github/workflows/ci.yml) · self-test (a hook self-test case, a lint_draft.py fixture, or a scripts/ci/self-test.sh case) · eval (a case directory under evals/, run by `claude plugin eval .`) · inspection (out-of-band: Rob reads the changed instruction text at the named file)
